newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech shares mixed in heavier trading on PSE.
newsitem.headline: Czech shares mixed in heavier trading on PSE.

text.p: The Prague Stock Exchange's post Senate election rally, as expected, ran out of steam on Tuesday, with major issues closing mixed in heavier trading.
The PX50 index edged up 0.3 points, or 0.06 percent, 514.6 while the Reuters RPIX index dipped 0.5 points to 1,058.5.

SPT Telecom, CEZ and Komercni Banka -- the bourse's three most-capitalised issues -- all gained ground, but several others including bank Ceska Sporitelna, confectioner Cokoladovny and most utilities fell.
Overall, 174 stocks rose, 120 fell and 58 traded unchanged. Total volume was heavier at 1.23 million shares on turnover of 772.5 million crowns.

Dealers said they had expected the market to slow up after a mini-bull run last week and on Monday following a strong showing by the centre-right governing coalition in the Senate vote at the weekend.
Some added that the upturn was more a technical rally than based on a change of market sentiment, and that it was mainly based in thin domestic buying.
